plan.title: feat(session,telemetry): #2994 process-cost events have no reader -- ceremony cost is write-only

narratives.Description: Issue #2994 already emits ceremony cost to .deft-cache/events.jsonl, but nothing reads it. Session:start prints no duration line even though duration_ms is in the JSON payload. This story adds one composed read surface and one operator-visible ceremony line without a new subsystem.
narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR: #2994 emits ceremony cost — tier, total ms, per-step ms, blocked-ritual events — to `.deft-cache/events.jsonl`. Nothing reads it. No CLI verb opens the log, `PROCESS_COST_EVENT_NAMES` has no consumer outside its own module, and `session:start` prints no duration line (`duration_ms` reaches the JSON payload only). Measured ceremony cost is write-only, which is #3500 ask 3.**

## Evidence

- Emit sites: `packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts:834,990,1057,1233,1681,1835`; `packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts:864,886,906`.
- `grep -rn PROCESS_COST_EVENT_NAMES packages --include=*.ts` (excluding `dist/`) resolves only to `process-cost.ts`, its own test, and `lifecycle/events.ts` — the latter for the payload contract, not a read.
- No file under `packages/cli/src` references `events.jsonl`.
- `SessionStartResult.payload.duration_ms` is populated; no human-readable line is pushed to `lines`.

## Ask

1. **One read surface.** A ceremony-cost rollup over `.deft-cache/events.jsonl`: last cold vs re-arm duration, per-step breakdown, blocked-ritual count, recovery-tier distribution. Compose an existing report verb — ⊗ new subsystem.
2. **One operator-visible line** on mutation `session:start`: ceremony tier + total. Respects `DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT` (#3286).

## Scope boundary

Process-cost measures **CLI process time**. #3500 reports agent-turn wall clock. These are different quantities, and the framework currently measures only the smaller one — which is why a cost complaint and the emitted telemetry can both be accurate and still disagree.

This issue delivers the CLI-side reader. Turn-level share stays with #3352 / #3320, where the disposition rule requires an emitted share rather than an impression.

⊗ Do not use a printed CLI ceremony duration as the #3286 Later graduation input.

Relates #3500 (ask 3), #2994 (emitter), #3282, #3320 (denominator + cite-emitted-data rule), #3352 (graduation tracker), #3286.

narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want to read ceremony cost from the existing events log, so that measured session time is not write-only.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Compose a ceremony-cost rollup into an existing report module such as packages/core/src/value/readback.ts that reads .deft-cache/events.jsonl and reports last cold vs re-arm duration, per-step ms, blocked-ritual count, and recovery-tier distribution.
2. Add one operator-visible session:start line in packages/core/src/session/session-start.ts (tier + total, respecting DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT) and cover both with tests. Do not invent a new subsystem.

narrative.Acceptance: When the composed report verb runs against events.jsonl, it prints last cold versus re-arm duration, per-step breakdown, blocked-ritual count, and recovery-tier distribution.
When mutation session:start finishes, it prints one ceremony-cost line with tier and total milliseconds unless DEFT_SESSION_COMPACT hides it.
When the story lands, PROCESS_COST_EVENT_NAMES has a consumer outside process-cost.ts itself and no new verb family is introduced.
